description: This file implements an AES encryption driver for the Lantiq platform, including hardware interaction, request queuing, and support for multiple AES modes such as ECB, CBC, CTR, and RFC3686. It registers cryptographic algorithms with the Linux kernel crypto API and manages asynchronous encryption requests via kernel threads and scatterlist processing.

methods.name: lq_deu_aes_core
methods.description: Main interface to hardware for AES encryption/decryption, handling key setup, DMA configuration, and data transfer.

methods.name: count_sgs
methods.description: Counts the number of scatterlist entries needed for a total byte size.

methods.name: lq_sg_init
methods.description: Initializes scatterlist mappings for source and destination buffers.

methods.name: lq_sg_complete
methods.description: Frees memory associated with an AES container after processing.

methods.name: aes_container_cast
methods.description: Retrieves the container structure from an ablkcipher_request.

methods.name: process_next_packet
methods.description: Processes the next data packet or scatterlist segment for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: process_queue
methods.description: Tasklet to trigger processing of queued AES requests.

methods.name: aes_crypto_thread
methods.description: Kernel thread managing AES request queue and hardware interaction.

methods.name: lq_aes_queue_mgr
methods.description: Manages queuing of AES requests, handling partial data and scatterlist segmentation.

methods.name: aes_setkey
methods.description: Sets the AES key in the context, validating key length.

methods.name: aes_generic_setkey
methods.description: Wrapper for setting AES key, used by specific cipher modes.

methods.name: rfc3686_aes_setkey
methods.description: Sets the key and nonce for RFC3686 mode.

methods.name: aes_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts data using queued requests and hardware acceleration.

methods.name: aes_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts data using queued requests and hardware acceleration.

methods.name: ecb_aes_encrypt
methods.description: ECB mode encryption.

methods.name: ecb_aes_decrypt
methods.description: ECB mode decryption.

methods.name: cbc_aes_encrypt
methods.description: CBC mode encryption.

methods.name: cbc_aes_decrypt
methods.description: CBC mode decryption.

methods.name: ctr_aes_encrypt
methods.description: CTR mode encryption.

methods.name: ctr_aes_decrypt
methods.description: CTR mode decryption.

methods.name: rfc3686_aes_encrypt
methods.description: RFC3686 mode encryption with nonce handling.

methods.name: rfc3686_aes_decrypt
methods.description: RFC3686 mode decryption with nonce handling.

methods.name: lqdeu_async_aes_init
methods.description: Initializes and registers AES algorithms with the Linux crypto API.

methods.name: lqdeu_fini_async_aes
methods.description: Unregisters AES algorithms and cleans up resources.
